changelog:
Initial release.

Features:
- Full Oura API v2 coverage: sleep (score, deep/REM/light, efficiency, HRV, HR), readiness (score, temperature deviation, contributors), activity (steps, calories, distance), heart rate, workouts, SpO2, stress, ring config, personal info
- Date-range queries (single day or arbitrary ranges)
- Score interpretation guide (0-100 bands, temperature deviation thresholds, HRV reading)
- Real sample outputs for every subcommand
- Companion API reference covering all v2 endpoints, OAuth scopes, rate limits, and date-semantics gotchas
- Privacy-first critical rules (never echo tokens.json / config.json; respect health data)

Pairs with the oura-cli companion tool at https://github.com/zqchris/oura-cli.
